results.summary: Responsive structure ✅ solid across all 16 tested pages including vendor-facing (pricing, vender) and auth (login, registration) pages. All pages have proper viewport meta, responsive grid system (col-md-*/col-lg-*), mobile nav toggle, and 12-language hreflang. Key issues: HIGH - EN pricing page has Spanish text 'Para siempre' in Free plan card. HIGH - EN /vender serves Spanish page (no English translation). HIGH - EN auth pages have Spanish footer newsletter text. Category listing still at 1.68 MB (previously reported). Responsive markup and structure are consistent across all tested pages.
